title: Concurrent ComputerWorker nacks start at most one Fargate host per generation
description:
Epic 8f98f8 requires concurrent demand to start at most one host. Live RunTask after ecs:TagResource raced several sleep-infinity tasks from parallel nacks. Claim the durable dispatch generation before RunTask so a second worker skips start_host.

```gherkin
Feature: Single host start dispatch
  Scenario: Concurrent pull workers start at most one host for one generation
    Given a fenced computer handoff with a queued continuation job
    And a recording host start driver
    When two computer-capable pull workers without a host executor pull that continuation concurrently
    Then the host start driver was invoked once
```

ThinTurn-only. Do not scale ChatticusComputers desiredCount. Do not cdk deploy --all.
